body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Prospect is Unsubscribed in Saleshandy trigger (Zoho) on Production, all 5 activities and the combined run:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create/Update a Contact in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho, unsubscribed with the real Unsubscribe link: the Prospects tab shows Unsubscribed, one contact is created with the mapped Contact Fields and one note. Existing contact with an old Title: the same contact is updated and no second contact is made. | Pass |
| 2 | Create/Update a Lead in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one lead created with the mapped Lead Fields and the prospect company, and one note. No contact is created. | Pass |
| 3 | Create/Update Account in Zoho | Prospect with a company and no contact: account created with the company name and the mapped Account Fields, not linked to a contact. | Pass |
| 4 | Create/Update a Deal in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho, Closing date 0: one deal created with the Deal Value as Amount and no contact linked. Contact with 2 deals: only the newest deal is updated and the older deal is unchanged. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Task in Zoho | Contact created, then one task linked to it with the configured Subject, Status, Priority and the due date set 3 days ahead. | Pass |
| 6 | Combined actions | Contact, Lead, Account, Deal and Task selected together: one contact, one lead, one deal and one task, and a note on the contact. | Pass |

**Note:** Only Unsubscribe with the real link was used for the Contact check. All other checks used Mark as Unsubscribe on the Prospects tab. The Unsubscribe tag was not checked. A deal also creates an account named after the company (known, Z-5). Pipelines and Stages cannot be chosen in the Deal Extra Configuration (known, AL-4199). A second open of the Unsubscribe link, Subscribe here and an empty Task Subject (AL-4198, verified through Email Sent) are not covered by this verification.
